verdict.rationale: OpenHands is itself a coding agent, which makes it the MCP client role; serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the pack shows OpenHands running as an MCP server: no 'mcp serve' mode and no hosted MCP endpoint. Its agent server exposes an HTTP/WebSocket API and its ACP support is for using other agents as backends, and neither is MCP server mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
